aoi.source: Live Mxwll boxes read from Roy's TradingView during 09:30-09:59 ET the same day
aoi.sell_short_tp: GREEN only (switched off: trade_colors is red only)

option.expiry: about 30 days out, at least 7, that one contract can afford

hold_to: 30 minutes at most (max_hold_minutes), and never past the 15:40 flatten

pulse_rules.note: Default rule for turning live readings into a Market Pulse bias. Each reading votes bullish (+1), bearish (-1) or not at all; the bias needs min_net_votes net votes, otherwise it is neutral, and neutral never contradicts a setup. Edit the thresholds to match how Roy reads the market.

mxwll._note: Python port of the Mxwll Suite (MPL 2.0, Mxwll Capital) in studies/mxwll.py. Matches Roy's TradingView chart: 5-minute candles with extended hours (04:00-20:00 ET). The settings form can switch extended hours on or off (settings.json on desk-state). Auto zones stay approximate (never tradable) until trusted is true, which only Roy sets after comparing them with his TradingView chart.

setup_note: Since 2026-10-07: the setup that came closest to break-even in the backtest (backtests/areas.md on desk-state; touch, red area only, no 2-signal minimum, 0.25% stop, sell after 30 minutes, a ~30-day option). It still lost a little in the backtest; this is paper practice, not a proven edge.
